updates.title: Retail sales (Oct)
updates.analysis: Retail sales came in at 0.2% against a 0.2% forecast, in line with expectations. The previous reading was 0.8%.
updates.context: Retail sales are reported in dollars. Changes can reflect prices as well as the volume of goods sold.
